key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration, triggering acute supply chain and retail property contagion.
Qantas flags a $1 billion surge in jet fuel expenses, cutting flight capacity and raising airfares.
RBA warns of persistent excess demand and rising unemployment requirements, dampening rate-cut expectations.
Housing market warnings intensify amid shrinking borrowing capacity and downside price risks.
ASX 200 dips late in the week but finishes net higher, supported by gold equity raisings and data centre resilience.

sectors.trend: Severe distress evidenced by David Jones entering administration and supplier non-payment.
sectors.implications: Downside risk for department store suppliers and retail spending proxies; shifts share to discount operators.

sectors.trend: Heightened anchor-tenant vacancy risk across shopping centres following major department store closures.
sectors.implications: Asset revaluation headwinds and leasing spread compression for major mall operators like Scentre Group (SCG.AX) and Vicinity Centres (VCG.AX).

sectors.trend: Mounting housing market vulnerability and borrowing capacity contraction amid persistent RBA rate pressure.
sectors.implications: Slowing mortgage loan growth and elevated tail risk for major bank credit books (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Fuel price shocks squeezing airline margins while clean energy capital priorities face fiscal scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Earnings headwind for Qantas (QAN.AX); consumer travel demand tested by fare hikes.

sectors.trend: Strong capital-raising momentum in gold and critical minerals exploration alongside Goldfields operational safety scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Constructive equity appetite for precious metals producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and explorers.

sectors.trend: Sustained institutional backing for digital infrastructure amid AI capacity buildout.
sectors.implications: Defensive growth characteristics for data centre operators like NEXTDC (NXT.AX).

key_themes: High-profile discretionary retail insolvency and mall vacancy contagion
Hawkish RBA stance driven by excess demand and inflation resilience
Accelerating residential property stress and borrowing capacity limits
Corporate margin compression from rising energy and fuel overheads
Safe-haven equity appetite driving gold sector capital raisings

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail REITs; focus on non-discretionary essential retail and industrial assets.
Limit exposure to high loan-to-value mortgage lenders; maintain strict allocation to well-capitalized tier-1 banks.
Reduce cyclical transport exposure vulnerable to jet fuel volatility and demand elasticity.
Allocate to cash, floating-rate notes, and defensive healthcare/staples with inelastic pricing power.

opportunities.rationale: Robust institutional capital inflows and macroeconomic uncertainty support precious metal miners.
Data centre operators benefit from structural AI demand regardless of domestic consumer weakness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Divest Discretionary Retail and Mall REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse elevates lease renegotiation and uncollected receivables risks across retail landlords.
$1 billion fuel cost increase and planned flight cuts will test consumer pricing tolerance.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Rotate into Resilient Consumer Staples and Healthcare
defensive_moves.rationale: Guards against household real-income stagnation and ongoing RBA restrictive policy.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile sideways trading for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) as retail insolvencies and energy costs offset broader index resilience.
market_outlook.long_term: Moderate performance divergence favoring resource exporters and secular tech over debt-dependent domestic cyclicals.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and commentary on excess demand
David Jones voluntary administration creditor proceedings and store closure outcomes
Crude oil and refined fuel benchmark price trajectories
Quarterly Australian CPI and labour market prints
watch_list: RBA cash rate guidance and unemployment rate changes
Commercial retail property vacancy rates (SCG.AX, VCG.AX)
Major bank credit impairment provisions (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX)
